data.text:
Dharampal Satyapal Limited vs The Food Safety Commissioner
on 10 September, 2024
Author: B.V. Nagarathna 
Bench: B.V. Nagarathna
 Item No.52 Court No.9 Section X
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Writ Petition(S)(Civil) No(S). 535/2024
 Dharampal Satyapal Limited & Anr. Petitioner(s)
 Versus
 The Food Safety Commissioner & Ors. Respondent(s)
 (Ia No. 191784/2024 - Ex-Parte Stay)
 With
 Slp(C) No. 20099/2024 (Ix)
 (For Admission and I.R. and Ia No.195677/2024-EXEMPTION From Filing
 C/C Of The Impugned Judgment)
 Date : 10-09-2024 These matters were called on for hearing today. 
 Coram :
 HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE B.V. NAGARATHNA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NONGMEIKAPAM KOTISWAR SINGH  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Mukul Rohatgi, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. C. S. Vaidyanathan, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Vivek Kohli, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Sanjai Kumar Pathak, AOR  Mr. Sameer Rohatgi, Adv.
 Mr. Nalin Talwar, Adv.
 Mr. Arvind Kumar Tripathi, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Mr. Aaditya A. Pande, AOR  Mr. Sourav Singh, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R SLP(C) No. 20099/2024:
Dharampal Satyapal Limited vs The Food Safety Commissioner on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193130811/
1 We have heard learned senior counsel for the petitioners. During the course of submissions, our attention was drawn to order dated 18.07.2023, which order was for a period of one year. As of today, the said period has lapsed and therefore, Reason:
the Notification impugned has run its course and is no longer in operation. 
In the circumstances, the Special Leave Petition does not call for any interference and the same is, accordingly, disposed of as infructuous,. 
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of. 
W.P. (C) No.535/2024:
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 24.09.2024. 
Issue notice on the interim prayers also. Dasti, in addition, is permitted. Mr. Aaditya A. Pande,
learned counsel accepts notice for respondent-State of Maharashtra. 
(RADHA SHARMA) (DIVYA BABBAR)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
Dharampal Satyapal Limited vs The Food Safety Commissioner on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193130811/
2
